generationInputs.prompt:
Create a visual storyboard for the continuation of 'El Despertar' as a SINGLE IMAGE arranged in a 2x4 grid layout (2 columns, 4 rows).

GRID LAYOUT INSTRUCTIONS:
- The image must be a single composite image divided into a 2x4 grid of 8 equal panels.
- Panels are numbered 1-8, left to right, top to bottom.
- Each panel should have a thin border separating it from adjacent panels and its frame number in the corner.
- All panels must be in vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.

This storyboard has EXACTLY 8 frames:

Panel 1: The Weigh-in. Vertical Medium Close-up. Mateo (stoic, defined muscles) and Viktor (shaved head, aggressive) face-off under harsh, cold white fluorescent lights.
Panel 2: Extreme Close-up of Mateo's unwavering, intense eyes reflecting the cold lights.
Panel 3: Vertical Close-up of Mateo's hands pulling white cotton bandages tight across his knuckles. Warm, moody lighting.
Panel 4: Vertical Medium Shot side profile. Coach's hand applying oil to Mateo's muscular shoulders, dramatic side lighting highlighting skin texture.
Panel 5: Vertical Low-angle shot. Mateo sits on a locker room bench with eyes closed in meditation under a single overhead spotlight.
Panel 6: Vertical Wide Shot from behind. Mateo's silhouette walking through a dark concrete tunnel towards a wall of blinding white light.
Panel 7: Vertical Low-angle front shot. Mateo emerges into the stadium light, thousands of camera flashes in the background.
Panel 8: Vertical Medium Shot through ring ropes. Mateo stands in the center of the ring, raising one fist, sweat glistening, intense stare at the camera.

STYLE CONSISTENCY:
- Maintain a consistent visual style (cinematic, high-contrast, atmospheric) across all panels.
- Ensure the fighter Mateo Ramos looks consistent (defined build, short dark hair, stoic expression) using the reference images provided.
- Color palette: Shifts from cold blues/whites in the weigh-in to warm ambers in the ritual, ending in high-intensity stadium whites/blues.
